title: 1. Prospectively isolate JOINT's initial-tilt sensitivity
hypothesis: Initial pen-axis misalignment, rather than larger position and joint offsets, is the dominant reset perturbation reducing frozen JOINT's rolling success.

prediction.against: baseline: frozen R-121 JOINT under position-and-joints-only 1.5x resets on identical cases
prediction.rationale: Predict JOINT success under tilt-only scaling minus position-and-joints-only scaling is at most -0.15, with the paired 95% t interval wholly below -0.15. This substantial fraction of D-089's approximately 0.28 full-reset loss prospectively tests D-094's replicated but unregistered tilt association. Fixed 512 pairs provide an informative contrast without another training run.

code_changes: scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: register tilt_reset_robustness using the existing frozen_robustness.py evaluation machinery and existing config; freeze all four 128-case manifests and the analysis specification before evaluation.

Existing cases.apply_condition and PenSpinBatchRunner(condition=) implementations: add separate scales for placement rotation rows 3-4 and the position/joint rows, retaining scalar reset_scale compatibility. Predeclare nominal=(1,1), tilt-only=(1.5,1), position-and-joints-only=(1,1.5), full=(1.5,1.5). Preserve all other reset semantics and physics.
Existing reset-condition tests: verify row selection, unchanged nominal behavior, and exact equivalence between full grouped 1.5x scaling and existing scalar 1.5x scaling without simulator episodes.

Existing frozen robustness evaluation machinery: evaluate frozen R-121 JOINT, frozen PPO expert and D-072 in all four conditions on identical base cases: 3 controllers x 4 conditions x 4 manifests x 128 cases. Preserve the original 360-step six-second task, per-step success definition and existing sustained-success scoring contract; no fitting, selection or installation.

Report remaining cells descriptively, including nominal/full continuity and PPO competence; archive transformed placements and initial tilt to verify intervention delivery. Stop after this protocol, with no adaptive sampling or controller-generation calls and a 60-minute wall-time cap.

result.notes: 48 cells (3 frozen controllers x 4 reset conditions x 4 fresh manifests, 6,144 episodes), no fitting, no model calls. One cell died at simulator start-up with the known allocator crash (malloc: unaligned tcache chunk) before writing anything; the driver was rerun and resumed at that cell, as documented for this crash; no completed cell was rerun. CONFIRMATORY: JOINT under tilt-only 1.5x minus JOINT under position-and-joints-only 1.5x on 512 identical cases: -0.139, paired 95% interval [-0.189, -0.089] (manifest-clustered [-0.164, -0.113]; 283 vs 354 successes; 54 wins, 125 losses). The interval excludes zero, so tilt scaling is clearly the more damaging perturbation, but it crosses the registered -0.15: INCONCLUSIVE on the registered magnitude. Descriptive: against nominal (0.777), JOINT loses 0.225 [-0.272, -0.177] under tilt-only, 0.086 [-0.130, -0.042] under position-only and 0.316 under both (0.461, reproducing D-089's full 1.5x result on new cases); the two effects are roughly additive. Tilt-only also costs the PPO expert 0.105 (0.998 -> 0.893; position-only costs it 0.008) and D-072 0.104, so wider initial tilt is harder for every controller; JOINT loses about twice as much as either. Under tilt-only JOINT's early drops rise from 27 to 60 of 512 and persistent-slow failures from 64 to 86. Delivery (reconstructed): mean initial tilt 0.599 rad nominal and position-only, 0.895 rad tilt-only and full; position and joint draws unchanged under tilt-only. Limits: one frozen lineage, one scale, position and joint draws scaled together, 512 pairs.

verdicts.reasoning: By the frozen rule: -0.139 [-0.189, -0.089] crosses the registered -0.15, so the effect size is neither supported nor refuted; the interval excludes zero, so the direction is established: scaling initial tilt hurts frozen JOINT more than scaling position and joint offsets (0.553 vs 0.691 on the same cases; -0.225 vs -0.086 against nominal). The loss is not specific to JOINT (PPO -0.105, D-072 -0.104 under tilt-only) but is about twice as large for it.
verdicts.next_experiment: The wide-reset weakness is mostly an initial-orientation effect, shared in part by the expert. Improving it is a capture-authority question (early drops before the module acts), outside what ARS continuation, mixtures or module edits changed in this direction: a new direction for the user.

direction: Continue Stage-3 Shadow Hand axial-rolling research from the frozen R-121 JOINT controller. Prioritize independent training reproducibility, then robustness of frozen controllers. Reproduce the successful residual-plus-recovery construction across independent training seeds before claiming a reliable learning algorithm. Evaluate longer horizons and predeclared physical/reset perturbations without fitting. Use archived failures to decide whether recovery hand-back deserves a state-dependent transition study. Then investigate whether LLM-guided construction can discover useful recovery-module structure against grammar search and the hand-designed template under matched budgets. Preserve the original six-second task and evaluation contract. Use JOINT as the experimental reference, preserve all existing assets, and leave default-incumbent installation separate. Run one protocol at a time through the existing advisor/implementer loop. Continue justified follow-ups within this direction; honor its escalation and exhaustion rules. No new global budget ceiling is imposed; each protocol must declare finite simulator, wall-time and model-call costs before agreement. No controller-generation calls for Q1–Q3. advisor.reasoning: Separately scaling reset components prospectively tests the tilt mechanism left unregistered by D-094, making this a justified frozen-robustness follow-up rather than another training study. Its weakest point is the 4,096 descriptive-comparator episodes, but those establish whether sensitivity is specific to JOINT or reflects general reset difficulty. The registered paired_success_difference decrease of at least 0.15 against JOINT's position-and-joints-only condition is falsified by a paired 95% interval wholly above -0.15; crossing that boundary is inconclusive, and including zero provides no directional evidence. The existing script/config, free seeds 5378–5381, 6,144 episodes, 60-minute cap and zero model calls make this a bounded spend without fitting or installation.

implementer.reasoning: Approve: a prospective, frozen-controller test of the one strong unregistered pattern from D-094, on fresh cases, with the contrast, its size and its interval fixed in advance; 48 cells, about 25 minutes, no fitting, no model calls. The runner extension is small (separate scales for the rotation rows and for the position and joint rows, with the scalar reset scale unchanged and tested equal to scaling both groups).
